title: Purchase Ledger Officer
company: Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club - Company - Permanent
description:
Role: Purchase Ledger Officer

Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Location: American Express Stadium, Brighton, BN1 9 BL

Contract Type: Permanent

Deadline Day: 1st October 2026

About Brighton & Hove Albion FC

We compete at the highest levels of football on a global stage while embracing our Sussex community spirit. At the heart of everything we do is our commitment to high performance, professional excellence, and making a positive impact. We are proud to have placed in the Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2026.

The team behind the team: Finance

Are you a dynamic, hardworking, and enthusiastic finance professional ready for a new challenge? Brighton & Hove Albion is seeking a dedicated Purchase Ledger Officer to join our team to play a crucial role in the financial engine of the club. You will take ownership of the club's purchase ledger, ensuring our suppliers are paid accurately and on time while maintaining strict compliance with our policies.

What we are looking for

We are looking for a collaborative, team-oriented problem solver who thrives under pressure and brings a pragmatic, curious mindset to their work.

Requirements:

An AAT L3 qualification (with experience) and proven experience working in Accounts Payable.

Demonstrable experience executing payment runs and working with SAP Concur and SAP Public Cloud.

Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, alongside excellent communication skills.

Our values are essential to our success

Our values serve as guiding principles for how we connect with one another, our fans, partners and sponsors. As a club, we embody these values in everything we do:
- Treat People Well
- Exceed Expectations
- Aim High. Never Give Up
- Act with Integrity
- Make it Special
- Be Fan Focused

How we say thank you

In appreciation for your hard work and dedication, we are pleased to offer you a range of additional benefits, including but not limited to:
- Complimentary breakfast and lunch at both sites
- 23 days holiday rising with length of service (pro rata for part time staff)
- Rewards platform, which includes access to 900+ retailers, a wellbeing centre and more!
- Enhanced family policies
- Access to a gym and padel court at our training ground
- Priority access to match tickets and access to free WSL tickets for 2026/27 season
- In-house training programme and CPD opportunities
- Exclusive discounts and benefits from our partners and local businesses

Our commitment to EDI

We take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace that reflects the diversity of our society and the world around us. Our core values foster a strong ethical culture, enabling us to meet the needs of our diverse audience, both on and off the pitch. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, and marriage or civil partnership. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support your application, please contact the team.

Safeguarding is part of everything we do

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults at risk. We expect all colleagues and volunteers to share this commitment.

This position is UK-based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including a full 3-year reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Package Description: Receptionist and Administrator Be the person who helps make primary care work for your Brighton community. For many of our patients, you'll be one of the first people they speak to when they need our help. That makes this much more than answering phones and booking appointments. At Allied Medical Practice, we're looking for a Receptionist and Administrator to join our team across School House Surgery and Church Surgery in Brighton. You'll help patients navigate our services, make sure information gets to the right people and support our clinical teams with the administration that keeps a busy GP practice running. Some days will be busy. Priorities can change quickly. You'll speak to people who are worried, frustrated or simply unsure where to turn. That's why we're looking for someone who is organised, calm, approachable and genuinely wants to help people. What you'll focus on Helping patients access the right care You'll be one of the first points of contact for our patients, whether they're speaking to us face-to-face or over the phone. You'll help with appointments, respond to queries and make sure patients are directed to the right person or service. Sometimes that means dealing with straightforward requests. At other times, you'll need to listen carefully, follow our processes and recognise when something needs to be escalated. Keeping the practice running smoothly There's a lot that happens behind the scenes in General Practice. You'll support the day-to-day administration that helps our clinical teams deliver care, including managing emails, correspondence, patient records and other administrative tasks. You'll need to be comfortable juggling different priorities while maintaining accuracy and confidentiality. Managing appointments and patient requests You'll book, amend and cancel appointments, helping us make the best use of the clinical time available. You'll also deal appropriately with urgent appointment requests and home visit requests, following practice procedures to make sure information reaches the right clinical colleague. Supporting prescriptions and referrals You'll support the processing of repeat prescription requests in line with practice procedures and help ensure they're dealt with efficiently. You'll also help process referrals from our GPs, making sure information is complete and sent to the appropriate service. Managing patient information Accurate information is essential to safe patient care. You'll help manage correspondence and hospital letters, update patient records, support new patient registrations and make sure information is coded, filed or passed to the appropriate member of the clinical team. You'll work with our clinical system, SystmOne, and maintain patient confidentiality at all times. Being part of the practice team You'll work closely with GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants, administrators and practice colleagues. Good primary care depends on people working together, so you'll communicate regularly with colleagues both within the practice and across other NHS and healthcare services. You'll be someone your colleagues can rely on to follow things through and get the details right. The kind of person who'll enjoy working here Our Brighton practices are developing and changing, so we're looking for someone who is comfortable being part of a service that continues to evolve. For this role, that doesn't mean we expect you to come in and transform General Practice. It means being willing to learn, being flexible when things change and approaching problems with a positive, practical attitude. You'll probably enjoy this role if you: Like helping people and providing good service Can stay calm and professional when someone is upset or frustrated Enjoy being busy and having a variety of things to do Are organised and pay attention to detail Can prioritise when several things need your attention Are comfortable using IT systems and learning new ones Can follow processes while using common sense Know when to make a decision and when to ask for help Work well as part of a team but can also get on with things independently Are dependable, punctual and take responsibility for getting things done Can adapt when priorities or ways of working change You don't need to know everything about General Practice on day one. What matters is that you're willing to learn, care about doing a good job and understand that even the smallest interaction can make a difference to a patient's experience. What you'll bring You'll need: A good standard of education, including Maths and English GCSE at grades AC or equivalent Experience working in General Practice or the NHS Practical experience of working with others Experience of working under your own initiative Experience using IT systems in a working environment Experience using clinical systems such as SystmOne or EMIS Excellent verbal and written communication skills Confidence dealing with people face-to-face and over the phone The ability to resolve problems calmly, including when under pressure Good time management and the ability to work to deadlines Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise and multitask A good understanding of confidentiality and the importance of protecting patient information A flexible, reliable and professional approach to work It would be great if you also have experience in customer service, understand basic medical terminology or have experience coding or summarising medical records. The environment you'll work in Allied Medical Practice operates across School House Surgery and Church Surgery in Brighton. You'll be joining at an important time for our Brighton practices. We're continuing to develop the way our teams work together and strengthen links across our wider Sussex primary care services, helping colleagues share knowledge, experience and support. Our practices are busy and our patients have a wide variety of needs, so no two days will be exactly the same. You'll be part of a team that is focused on providing a good service to our patients while continuing to improve how we work. Who are we? We are Integrated Care 24 (IC24), the leading not-for-profit Social Enterprise providing innovative and patient-focused primary care services. IC24 is committed to improving access to health and social care for our patients and reducing demand on secondary care services. We provide services to over six million patients, including GP Out of Hours, NHS 111, Primary Care and Integrated Urgent Care services. Every day, our people help patients access the care they need, when they need it most. What's in it for you? Hourly pay rate of £12.71 6.6 weeks of annual leave per annum Access to the NHS Pension Scheme Learning and development opportunities to support your career journey Employee Assistance Programme including free 24/7 counselling support Access to health and wellbeing initiatives Blue Light Card discounts Colleague recognition and reward schemes The opportunity to make a real impact within a growing Social Enterprise Location: Allied Medical Practice School House Surgery & Church Surgery, Brighton Hours: 32 hours per week We celebrate brave ideas and brave people. Due to the nature of this position, employment is subject to proof of eligibility to work in the UK, a satisfactory standard DBS check and satisfactory references. We have a duty to safeguard, protect and promote the welfare of those who use our services and our employees. This means we take every step we can to protect people from harm, abuse and neglect. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including ethnic minority communities, disabled people, LGBTQ+ communities, neurodiverse individuals and other under-represented groups. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels they belong. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team. Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Administrator

We are looking for a reliable, enthusiastic, and organised individual who takes pride in delivering excellent administrative support. You will have a keen eye for detail, strong interpersonal skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. If you are passionate about helping others, have strong communication skills, and are looking to develop your career within the NHS, we would love to hear from you.
